correctness.rationale: The novel kernel identity follows by summing the published exact second difference of path greedy expectations. Its first three discrete difference ratios have verified strict signs for every \(j\ge1\); checkerboard pairing proves positivity of \(\eta_j\) and \(\\(\eta_j\)-\eta_{j+1}\), and an alternating series proves positive on-path difference for KC paths of length >=2. For length one, a neighbor of the source endpoint witnesses strict component splitting, with \(1+\alpha_b>\alpha_{b+1}\) and \(\alpha\)-subadditivity. Cited nonnegative off-path terms and the KC poset plus first-vertex induction prove all-order unique path minimization. Exact checker passed 30741 assertions (orders through 11); finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The prior same-object theorem expressly leaves open uniqueness of minimizers. The strict structural KC shattering lemma closes a mathematically motivated equality gap for all finite trees, gives an explicit proof mechanism that is distinct from false expectation KC monotonicity, and does not merely compute an incidental finite invariant.
